title: Stakeholder Sprint Diary and Readiness Telemetry
content:
Purpose:
This is a hybrid sprint diary + telemetry snapshot designed to capture the week-by-week state of launch readiness for the Q4 model-serving rollout. The goal is to give cross-functional stakeholders a single narrative that pairs qualitative signal (notes, blockers, decisions) with a small, fast KPI telemetry snapshot that the ops lead can update each week.

Scope:
- Focused on the initial public beta release for Hosted API + Dedicated fallback.
- Covers capacity, latency, quality (manual eval sets), and operational guardrails.
- Not a complete runbook (see linked playbooks); this is the running status and near-term action list.

How to use this file:
- Product Ops owns the weekly update on Mondays; engineering owners update the specific checklist items inline.
- Use the Contingency Lattice section when considering an early rollback vs. degraded mode decision.
- Keep this doc minimal — link detailed telemetry dashboards rather than pasting large tables.

WEEKLY SPRINT DIARY (rolling notes)
2024-09-30 (baseline capture)
- Weekly lead-in call: agree to soft launch on 2024-10-14 target.
- Capacity probe passed: Dedicated pool initial throughput at 70% of target; needs +2 nodes for 95th percentile headroom.
- Blocker: prefix caching bug increases P95 latency for mixed-batch generation. Ticket PO-1129 assigned to Diego.
- Action: toggle conservative batching in config; re-run load test on 2024-10-02.

2024-10-07
- Load retest: P95 latency improved from 420ms to 260ms after conservative batching change. Cost per 1k tokens increased ~8%.
- Eval: small manual eval shows zero regressions on our fidelity checklist (hallucination examples stable).
- Stakeholder ask: product wants a canary with 5% traffic and an immediate fallback to smaller model on errors.
- Decision pending: fallback policy needs SRE signoff for metrics to trigger.

2024-10-14 (planned soft launch)
- Soft launch executed at 09:15 UTC. Canary at 3% (reduced from 5% because of observed regional latency).
- Observed: one region (eu-west-1) reported elevated queueing at 11:00–11:12; automatic fallback to Dedicated not triggered due to mismatched model tags.
- Postmortem action: add model-tag aliasing to routing policy; patch rolled at 12:40 UTC.

2024-10-21
- Canary expanded to 10% after patch. No user-facing incidents. Minor increase in error budget consumption for short prompt patterns.
- Product ops note: reduce sampling window for quality checks to daily rather than weekly for the first month.

KPI TELEMETRY SNAPSHOT (small, fast metrics for the diary)
- Date: 2024-10-21
- Canary traffic: 10%
- Avg latency (2-token sample): 95ms hosted, 120ms dedicated
- P95 latency: 260ms hosted, 310ms dedicated
- Error rate (5xx): 0.06% overall (target <0.1%)
- Cost delta (conservative batching): +8% per 1k tokens
- Quality regressions on eval-set: 0/120 samples flagged
- KV cache hit rate (in-host): 42% (goal 50% within 2 weeks)

READINESS CHECKLIST (status, owner, notes)
- Canary routing policy verified: status=done, owner=Evan Chu, notes=added aliasing rule for compatible variants.
- Rollback button & playbook validated: status=done, owner=Priya Narang, notes=playbook linked in #launch-ops.
- Billing/quota alerts configured: status=in_progress, owner=Marta Svensson, notes=thresholds set but alert suppression rules need review.
- Security review (VPC/policy): status=done, owner=Diego Alvarez.
- Privacy/compliance checklist: status=done, owner=Jordan Kim.
- Load testing coverage for international regions: status=partial, owner=Diego Alvarez, notes=apac and latam still missing.
- End-to-end telemetry traces enabled for token paths: status=done, owner=Evan Chu.
- Experimentation flag gating: status=done, owner=Product, notes=feature flag EXP_CANARY active.

CONTINGENCY LATTICE (unique: scenario => pre-commit decision thresholds + immediate action)
1) Scenario: Region-level latency spike > 2x baseline for > 5 minutes
   - Threshold signals: P95 > 2x baseline AND queue length > 75th percentile
   - Immediate action: reroute 100% of new traffic from that region to nearest healthy region (SRE runbook).
   - Escalation: if reroute fails or error-rate > 0.5%, initiate rollback to previous model variant.

2) Scenario: Quality regression detected (automated eval) impacting >3% of sampled requests
   - Threshold signals: daily eval fail rate >3% AND manual spot-check confirms false positives < 20%
   - Immediate action: reduce canary traffic to 0% and roll traffic to safe variant; enable manual inspection by Research.
   - Escalation: stop public rollout and assemble triage war room.

3) Scenario: Cost per 1k tokens rises >20% vs baseline
   - Threshold signals: 7-day rolling increase >20% AND unit-economics breach defined in pricing doc
   - Immediate action: switch to conservative batching policy and enable cheaper quantized variant for non-sensitive customers.
   - Escalation: consult GTM for pricing impact and pause beta expansion.

CANARY EXPANSION RUBRIC (simple rule-of-thumb)
- Safety gates: all critical alerts green, daily eval fail rate <1%, P95 within 1.5x baseline for two consecutive days.
- Expansion steps: 3% -> 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Each step minimum 48 hours observation window.
- Abort criteria: any red action in Contingency Lattice triggers immediate halt.

PRELAUNCH HOUR + DAY CHECKLIST (owner + exact action)
- D-1: Final smoke run through canary routing; confirm no certificate/key expiry in next 30 days (owner: Marta).
- D-1: Confirm alert pager rotations and escalation contacts (owner: Priya).
- D-1: Freeze non-essential merges to deployment branch (owner: Release Eng).
- H-0: Run small synthetic traffic spike (owner: Evan) and confirm autoscale behaves for 2 mins.
- H+1: Manual quality sample by Research team from live traffic (owner: Diego).

OPEN QUESTIONS / DISCUSSIONS (for Monday ops sync)
- Are we comfortable with the +8% cost delta for the first 30 days to avoid P95 regressions? Product wants hard limit of +5% if possible.
- Should we prioritize adding APAC load tests before the next expansion to 25%? Engineering leaning yes.
- Can Product accept a temporary model-size fallback for price-sensitive customer segments? (GTM input requested)

ACTION ITEMS (short, owner, due)
- Diego: finish APAC load tests + edge-region validation (due 2024-10-25).
- Priya: finalize alert suppression rules and runbook excerpts in Confluence (due 2024-10-22).
- Evan: instrument an extra sampling tracer for negative prompt patterns (due 2024-10-23).
- Marta: confirm billing notification thresholds and add one escalation recipient (due 2024-10-22).
- Jordan: prepare two-paragraph executive summary for the 10/28 leadership review (due 2024-10-26).

NOTES TO SELF (product-ops shorthand)
- Keep diary entries terse; tie every qualitative note to at least one KPI if possible.
- Prefer links to dashboards over pasting heavy tables.
- Use this doc as the single source of truth for near-term decisions; snapshot to Confluence weekly (see linked_artifacts).

Appendix: quick references
- Playbook: confluence:PRODOPS-3245
- Incident ticket template: jira:INC-0000 (copy template under /templates)
- Rollback checklist: github:repo/launch-configs PR#78 details

End of diary entry.
